specs_json.compute: Onboard industrial PC; optional NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX high-compute module

notes: The Unitree B2 (2023) is an IP67-rated industrial quadruped weighing ~60 kg that carries up to 40 kg standing (120 kg static) and sprints over 6 m/s — among the fastest industrial quadrupeds. Its 2250 Wh hot-swappable battery gives 4-6 h of walking endurance. It targets inspection, logistics, and hazardous-environment missions in all weather.

failure_modes.name: IP67 seal degradation
failure_modes.symptoms: Moisture ingress alarms, corrosion on connectors, electronics faults after rain/washdown operations
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressure-test seals on maintenance schedule, replace gaskets annually, inspect after chemical exposure

failure_modes.name: Knee actuator overload at max payload
failure_modes.symptoms: Torque saturation warnings, sagging stance under 40 kg load, elevated motor temps on slopes
failure_modes.mitigation: Derate payload for slope/stair missions, monitor per-joint torque headroom, rotate high-load duty across fleet

failure_modes.name: Lidar contamination in dusty/industrial sites
failure_modes.symptoms: Point-cloud dropouts, phantom obstacles, localization jumps, mission aborts
failure_modes.mitigation: Clean optical windows per shift in dirty environments, fuse with cameras/IMU odometry, add protective cowling

failure_modes.name: High-current battery contactor failure
failure_modes.symptoms: Sudden full power loss mid-mission, robot collapses, no fault forewarning
failure_modes.mitigation: Log contactor cycle counts, replace at rated cycles, verify emergency-stop behavior in safety zone

failure_modes.name: Foot force sensor drift
failure_modes.symptoms: Gait timing errors, stumbling on terrain transitions, incorrect contact detection
failure_modes.mitigation: Recalibrate zero-load offsets weekly, replace sensors showing drift beyond spec

failure_modes.name: High-speed gait resonance / fastener loosening
failure_modes.symptoms: Rattling at >5 m/s, gradual loosening of leg covers, vibration alarms
failure_modes.mitigation: Torque-check fasteners on interval, apply threadlocker, limit sustained sprint duration
